title: Mobile Developer
description:
About the role
We are hiring a Mobile Developer for our Engineering team (Austin, TX (on-site)).

What you will do
- Work with designers and backend developers
- Build and ship features for our mobile apps
- Publish releases to the app stores

What you bring
- At least 2 years of relevant experience
- Solid working knowledge of React Native, Git, Swift and Mobile UI Design

Nice to have
- REST APIs and iOS
